subject: mcp: remove the coverage surface (untested_surface, affected, coverage_gaps)
body:
Follows grove's removal of heuristic test-coverage edges (measured 4-12%
recall vs real runtime coverage — an unreliable "untested gap" signal).
With the underlying edges gone, every coverage-facing surface is removed:

- MCP tools: prism_untested_surface, prism_affected + their handlers,
  schemas, descriptions, and tool-list/http entries.
- prism query: the coverage_gaps include, buildCoverageGaps + testedChecker,
  the coverageGaps result field, and the covering-tests block in
  code_context delivery. Default include is now ["graph"]; "tests" is no
  longer a category (a lexically task-matched test carries no verified
  relation to the anchor, so test symbols are never delivered).
- prism verify: drops the "affectedTests" section (was AffectedTests).
- grove client: UntestedSurface / Tests / AffectedTests wrappers + the
  "tests" edge-kind mapping + UntestedSurfaceResult/CoverageSite types.
- CLI: untested-surface / affected commands, help, and the embedded
  guidance-table rows. assist tool registry: untested_surface removed.

prism_verify's completeness gate (the actual product) is untouched — it
was never built on tests edges. go test ./... green.
